t: Where do you get your plywood at a decent price? | LumberJocks Woodworking Forum
s: Same mom and pop lumber shop I've always got my plywood. I haven't noticed the price jump too much if at all. This is purely conjecture, but I think the lumber industry has not been hit by supply chain issues nearly as bad as other industries. However, I do believe the big box places saw a great opportunity to price gouge and blame it on the pandemic. ... I go to a hardwood and lumber supplier as well. I have a business account with them and buy small, but regularly.
